title: Selecting and extending a list
description: You can read the first element, the remaining list and a new front element.

steps.description: You bind L to the symbols a, b and c in order. car selects a, while cdr returns the list (b c).

steps.question: What list does cons produce when it places z before L?
steps.answer: It produces (z a b c), with z as the new first element.

steps.description: You see (z a b c) as the cons result. The expression constructs a new list beginning with z.
null? returns #t for the empty list. pair? also returns #t for L, which is a nonempty list.
